name: First Quilt
character: Spring green and patient type: a teaching guild for adults making the first quilt they will actually finish.

sections.title: {{guild_name}}
sections.subtitle: Sample text — replace me: {{guild_name}} is for adults on quilt number one. We meet {{meeting_info}}. You will leave with a finished throw before we talk about a second top.

sections.heading: When we sew
sections.note: Machines are provided for the first three meetings if you do not own one yet. Bring fabric for a 12-inch nine-patch, or use the class pack.

items.title: The path
items.body: Nine-patch, sandwich, quilt, bind. Four months. No mystery, no BOM with twelve techniques.

items.title: Machine nights
items.body: We thread, wind, and unpick as a group. Tension is a lesson, not a personality test.

items.title: Then you graduate
items.body: After the throw is bound you join a regular guild or stay as a mentor. This room stays aimed at first quilts.

sections.title: Join {{guild_name}}
sections.body: Dues are collected once a year.

sections.title: About {{guild_name}}
sections.subtitle: Sample text — replace me: A guild that refuses to skip the first quilt.

sections.heading: How we started
sections.html: Sample text — replace me: Shops teach a Saturday. Regular guilds assume you already know a quarter-inch. {{guild_name}} sits in the gap: adults in {{city}} who want a finished quilt, not a drawer of samples. Mentors are members who finished here last year.

items.title: Mentor term
items.body: Graduates may sit a year as helpers. After that, we send you to a guild with a show and a bee.

sections.title: The First Path
sections.subtitle: Sample text — replace me: What you make, what we provide, and what you buy.

items.title: Month 1
items.body: Grain, 1/4 inch, nine-patch. You will unpick. That is the class.

items.title: Month 2
items.body: Sashing and borders. Press toward the dark. Square the top.

items.title: Month 3
items.body: Baste, quilt in the ditch or a simple grid, trim.

items.title: Month 4
items.body: Bind. Label. Photograph. Then we talk about quilt two.

sections.heading: What to buy
sections.html: Sample text — replace me: If you have a machine, bring it. If not, use ours for the cohort. Fabric: three one-yard cuts that contrast. We sell a pack at cost if choosing fabric is the thing that has stopped you.

sections.title: Membership
sections.subtitle: Sample text — replace me: Cohort dues include the room, batting for the throw, and binding tape if you want it. Your fabric is yours.

items.q: I already made a quilt twenty years ago.
items.a: If it is finished, a regular guild will fit better. If it is in a bag, bring the bag. We will treat it as quilt one.
This cohort is 18 and up. The youth guild in town is better at that age.
